fields: She is slippery and her charm is a real threat, but as a support she lacks the gold she needs and usually underperforms.
Bully him hard at level 1 before he can use his combo. Avoid getting caught by his headbutt-pulverize and you outscale him heavily; one of your best matchups.
His ult is a huge teamfight tool, but its long cooldown gives you many windows to force fights with your own ult while his is down.
Mage supports like Annie are immobile, which makes them easy ult targets, and they cannot burst you once you have one or two items.
An Ashe support is a very favorable draft for you; just play normally.
Dangerous if you or your ADC cannot dodge his hook; he punishes your roams and zones your ADC well. With confident movement the lane is manageable.
Learn his skillshot habits and avoid eating everything and the lane is easy. Your ult gives free picks or forces Flashes whenever it is up.
His shield stops your Q from passing through to stun a second target or wall. If his passive stacks on you alongside an aggressive ADC like Lucian or Samira, you can die quickly.
Respect his CC early or you can die. From level 6 he can follow your roams with his ult. Keep your distance early and you outscale him, much like against Alistar.
A skill matchup: a good Janna is hard to catch and peels very well, making engages difficult and trading tough. A weak Janna dies whenever you land a stun or ult.
One of the hardest lanes: her empowered Q bullies you and her empowered E scales into fights and makes landing your spells difficult. The author considers her worth banning.
Even with Unflinching she can kill you early. Survive laning and she becomes far less useful than you.
She bullies you in lane and scales equally well, and her speed boosts make your ult hard to land. Worth banning.
An immobile mage; trust your dodging and hope your ADC dodges well too.
Very hard: you cannot win brush control against his saplings, his W engage is reliable, and his ult peels for his team or counters your ult engages.
His E shield and passive let him win lane trades, and his range and attack speed buffs scale well. He can cleanse your stun off allies, though not your ult's stasis.
Like Ashe support, a favorable draft for you.
Her Black Shield counters your whole kit, blocking both your stun and ult, especially if she maxes it first. If your Q breaks the shield, the stun still lands. Worth banning.
Her W trades bully you in lane, but she scales less than other enchanters, so stay patient.
Like Leona: avoid being chain-CC'd and killed early, then you outscale. His ult is slow and obvious, so your ult can negate it.
A weak support pick, essentially a lesser Leona or Nautilus.
A cheesy early pick with good tools against you: tunnelling often lines you up for her stun, and her W blocks your tunnel. Easy to die early, but you outscale.

His hook is hard to dodge since he can hold it, and watch for a level 1-2 E-Flash engage. If he does not snowball ult resets you outscale, though vision control gets hard once he finishes Umbral Glaive.
Slippery and rarely catchable. With Xayah the 2v2 is strong, but with others you can bully him. His W knockup becomes easy to dodge with practice.
Bully her hard in lane. After she commits W she is an easy target for you and your ADC; avoid clumping with allies so she gets no free engage.
Squishy and immobile early but with unique outplay tools. Your tankiness makes her W revive hard to trigger off you, and you can ult yourself like a Zhonya's while her ally dies again.
She struggles into ranged supports. Deny her free souls in lane and she becomes an immobile target for your ult.
Very annoying and she outranges you, making trades hard. From level 6 you can start making plays; do not line up with teammates when her ult is up and stay patient.
She outranges your autos, so be patient until level 6. She is very squishy, so any CC you land should be lethal.
Take Ignite and avoid small trades; either commit for the kill or do not trade, since she out-sustains you. Dodge her Qs and wait for level 6.
A mage support you handle well, but his E snare hitbox can be deceptive, so give it room.
Still a strong laner, but since his devour became his ult he is much worse at stopping your picks. You can bully him fairly hard early.
Walk perpendicular as soon as he throws his stun and it will miss unless he Flashes. Your ult can neutralize his invulnerability window.
One of your worst lanes: his lantern saves anyone you try to ult, and you can die quickly to a hook or flay. Worth banning.
An immobile mage; avoid eating every skillshot and you win.
An immobile mage; avoid his skillshots and you win.
She cannot follow your roams or punish your ADC while you are away, but if an ally of hers gets fed you cannot stop them. If she detaches as your Q lands, she can stun herself.
His speed boosts and revive are strong anti-pick tools against you; you largely rely on the Zilean being weak. He is rare, so the author does not consider him ban-worthy.
An immobile mage; dodge her skillshots and you win.
